pre_america.rule: Focal team is Atlético de San Luis and the match ID year is 2022 or 2023.

america_championship_context.rule: Focal team is América and match year is 2024 or earlier.

post_championship_context.rule: Focal team is América and match year is after 2024.

other_context.rule: The focal team or match ID year does not match the contextual stages above.
other_context.period: Excluded from the three focal narrative stages

limitations: partidos.competencia and partidos.fecha are empty in the source database
stage labels are contextual and do not independently prove tournament membership; Atlético de San Luis matches after 2023 are excluded from the pre-América stage
coordinate direction is not normalized; PPDA uses raw x <= 72 while high actions use the source ATTACKING_THIRD zone
